title: Kaidoro
description: Founder & Software Engineer. An AI-powered planning platform that turns learning and career goals into phased, adaptive roadmaps, with one canonical structure viewable three ways: an Excel checklist, an interactive node graph, and a self-paced course. Full-stack build: React/TypeScript frontend, Python/FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, authentication and Gemini API integration. Live at kaidoro.app in private testing (access-code gated), opening to the public once the system is scaled.

title: RoomQuest
description: Selected as 1 of 52 participants from 1,000 applicants for a Google-run AI hackathon. Led a 5-person team at the Google Student AI Hackathon (London), building a working demo that generates room-aware puzzle clues via Gemini multimodal vision in under 5 seconds through an AI Studio → Antigravity → Google Cloud workflow, then presenting a go-to-market strategy alongside the technical demo.

title: Student Performance Predictor
description: End-to-end machine learning regression pipeline predicting student exam scores from 13 numerical and categorical features. Compared four models (Linear Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) using MAE, RMSE, R² and 5-fold cross-validation. Selected Linear Regression as the final model (R² = 0.825, MAE = 0.415): the ensemble methods never earned back the complexity they added.

title: FocusFlow API
description: RESTful productivity analytics API with JWT authentication, SQLAlchemy ORM and PostgreSQL. Built analytics endpoints using SQL aggregation queries for productivity trends, category breakdowns and study streaks.

title: Coursework Deadline Optimiser
description: Full-stack coursework management app with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and JWT auth. Scheduling algorithm prioritises study time based on deadline urgency, task difficulty and course weighting. CI/CD deployment via GitHub and Render.

title: Loughborough University Route Finder
description: A* pathfinding with Euclidean heuristic for optimised campus routing with obstacle avoidance and multi-waypoint support. Graph visualisation using NetworkX and Matplotlib with coordinate-mapped nodes and edge weights.

title: Notion PDF Exporter
description: Native macOS app that batch-converts an entire exported Notion workspace to PDFs, preserving folder structure, formatting, callouts and tables. Runs 100% locally: no subscription, no account, no data leaving the machine.

title: AI Study Assistant
description: Flutter mobile app that turns uploaded lecture-note PDFs into structured study material: summaries, key topics, flashcards and quiz questions, via a FastAPI backend and the Gemini API, with Firebase auth and a PostgreSQL-backed analysis history.

title: LEDController
description: Native macOS menu-bar app for Bluetooth LE LED strip control, with real-time screen-sync lighting powered by ScreenCaptureKit, K-means dominant-colour extraction and Apple Vision scene classification.

title: VolumeController
description: Menu-bar utility that controls multiple macOS audio output devices independently via CoreAudio's HAL directly: no virtual driver or kernel extension required, unlike alternatives such as BackgroundMusic.
